svg.title: Expense itemizer wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / EXPENSES / ITEMIZER
Applying a template adds one editable line per category. Amounts stay editable.
Food changed from $800 to $900. The total and the plan expense update on save.
Deleting a line lowers the total and the plan expense. The save is one request.
One total feeds the engine. The itemized lines stay as the
Templates offer categories; applying one creates editable line items, not an opaque total.
Editing food to $900 updates the total and stores that total as the living-expense event.
Deleting a line removes it from the total. One request saves the items and the resulting total.
The plan still reads one living-expense event; the itemization is the audit trail behind it.
